question: Does a publicly reprinted passage of Wang Miao's 2005 article conflate Wanli ji-hai with 1600, and what can the already source-verified Xu-An/Wang paratext establish independently?

bibliography.first_party_title: 明末邢云路《古今律历考》探析
bibliography.reprint_provenance: Secondary website '来源：不详'; exact published-journal text or OCR/modern-editor fidelity unverified

reprint_passage.quoted_later_republication_target: 胡来朝「后序」quoted as starting 「己亥秋」; reprint then paraphrases 「万历己亥（1600）秋」 and conjectures printing in 1600 or next year
reprint_passage.calendar_check: Wanli 27 己亥 maps to 1599; Wanli 28 庚子 maps to 1600. Parenthetical 1600 attached to 己亥 is internally contradictory.
reprint_passage.invalid_inference: The republished 1600 parenthetical cannot itself certify the year of 己亥秋, and a speculative 1600-or-1601 printing window is not a source-original impression certificate.
reprint_passage.scope_note: This does not disprove that a revised/assembled edition or some physical impression postdates a 庚子1600 preface. Date of a preface is not the date of all plates or the currently observed juan45 sheets.

prior_direct_original_paratext.prior_visual_record: 徐安後敘 萬曆歲在屠維大淵獻 [屠維=己、大淵獻=亥] = 1599; not juan45 impression date
prior_direct_original_paratext.prior_visual_record_wang: 王邦俊序 萬曆庚子春三月 = 1600, same accession but not proof of precise juan45 sheet date

date_layer_firewall.preface_and_postface_dates: 1599 Xu dated postface and 1600 Wang dated preface known from prior original-image evidence
date_layer_firewall.physical_copy: NLC item identity as previously registered, no new separately verified historical exemplar
date_layer_firewall.digital_surrogate: Prior NLC scans plus modern public web secondary reprint; cannot date any original printed sheet by digital publication time
date_layer_firewall.reprint_date: 2009 website copy is not 2005 publisher original and not 1599/1600 original text
date_layer_firewall.non_equivalence: 1699/1600 etc cannot be inferred from a mistaken modern parenthetical or title/identical passages

source_register_and_transmission_impact.explicit_non_edge: A public 2009 reprint and 2005 journal bibliographic record are not two independent ancient witnesses; same-accession dated paratext does not date juan45 target sheet.
source_register_and_transmission_impact.remaining_question: Does 2005 publisher PDF actually contain the '己亥（1600）' parenthetical? Keep original-journal attribution unawarded until directly observed.

next_action: Prioritize independent authenticated Xu-An original juan45 B L132 readable terminal 二/三 and source-native 疾捷法/少微 radix/carry. Do not repeat a catalog-only facsimile, NPM explicitly non-digitized record, or same-copy ROI without stronger pixels; do not infer printed-year or numerical winner from the reprint's parenthetical.
